raw_text: Follow `RULES.md` strictly; repo tooling and explicit user instructions win. Read every file you modify in full before editing it. Do not remove, rename, or downgrade intentional functionality unless the user explicitly asked for it. Do not “fix” dependency or type problems by deleting behavior or weakening checks. Do not bypass hooks, checks, or validation steps. Never use `--no-verify`. Never commit unless the user explicitly asks. Do not open PRs unless the user explicitly asked. Do not merge or close anything unless the user explicitly asked. If a conflict appears in untouched files, stop and ask the user. Use explicit paths when staging. Never use broad staging commands that can capture other agents’ work. `git add <specific-file-paths>` `git pull --rebase` `git reset --hard` `git clean -fd` `git commit --no-verify` Store transient agent context, scratch notes, logs, and task state under `.llm/{DIR}/`. Do not use `.context/` for new work.
